notes.title: Early spring update.
notes.notes:
Greetings, hunters. 

With this spring update we are proud to present a fully reworked server management system, new gameplay mechanics, HUD enhancements, and quality of life improvements. 

🔥 Fully reworked server management system

 Multiplayer game sessions are now displayed correctly. 
 Fully functional public and private sessions.
 Every game session now has a Lobby ID that can be shared for easily joining a session.


📖 New Focus Mode 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/4cc71e93401b48c39cda1c352bdd9ee3117bbd85.png
In all haunted locations hunters can now find collectible journals related to the mysterious cult and the horrors that take place in SO BELOW.

🏚️ Cinematic scenes will play when interacting with the journals and focusable objects.
🕰️ Uncover lost fragments of the past and learn the secrets hidden in every map.
🔍 Learn more about the Ascendants, about HEXA, and piece together the truth behind every contract.

👁️ New Object: Hand Radar 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/ddf3fc36313ae59144489a903cba055a528ee051.png
The brand new Hand Radar is a powerful new investigation tool that can detect haunted objects and entities in a wide area of action. Available at the mobile stores.

🧩 Detect entities, haunted objects, and other hunters.
⚡ Minigame for charging the hand radar battery.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/46e0f9a5a00923e9ea209951c29364ec5c79f687.jpg
⚙️ Other changes

 Balanced pricing for the hunting item store.
 Enhanced hand tool meshes and visuals.
 Greenwood forest map enhancements.
 Improved lamp FX & performance.
 Shroud ghost sound and visual enhancements.
 Nun balance updates.
 St. Philip Church now available for all entities.
 Dorje relic fixes for the shadows.
 Relic rumble feedback during entity fights.
 New EMF mesh and sound.
 New money transaction UI.
 Controller pointer for easier interaction.
 General map navigation balance.
 Complete HUD layout rework.
 Unified inventory for all kinds of objects.


👁️ Get ready for a more immersive experience with this update. Dare enter the world of SO BELOW and unveiling its secrets. Please share your thoughts and comments, and as always, DON’T DIE!!!

notes.title: Haunted Christmas patch notes
notes.notes:
Greetings Hunters, and happy holidays! 


We are happy to bring you a small but important patch for this holiday season.

Enhanced controller support: New controller mapping and overall improvements. Added rumble functionality based on pain.

New UI: Updated visuals and functionality of various menus and user interfaces. New Main menu, settings and key bindings menu pages.

New torch behavior: The torch and flashlight now appear turned on when changing inventory (easier to fight off wendigos).

Focus mode: New focus mechanic to expose lore and operate mechanical objects with the controllers. 

Xmas office: Seasonal Christmas decorations are on, get a picture with the team next to the tree. 

Greenwood forest enhancements: The Greenwood Forest is the first one to receive a bunch of lore exposition through diaries and focusable interest points. New aesthetics to fit the lore, as well as improved navigation with better lighting and landmarks, as well as maps.
 
Lure machine enhancements: Improvements to the lure machine regarding localization and functionality. 

Footprint mechanic: All the entities now display some sort of footprint, even when teleporting. This facilitates the environmental awareness of the hunters.

Crucifix journal page: New default journal page with information regarding the types of entities and their weaknesses, as well as a guide to crucifixes and cursed objects.

Added missing Localization: Some new objects were missing localization to Japanese, Italian and French. 

Bug fixing: We have been fixing the bugs that you guys reported since the last update. There’s maybe some more for you to discover though (please report bugs on our discord channel). 

As always, thank you for hunting entities for us. We hope you get scared and frustrated enough to finish the Wendigos, but happy enough to keep coming back. 
From Eonia Studio, Happy holidays!

notes.title: 2nd Anniversary update
notes.notes:
Happy spooky season hunters, it’s been 
a while! 

Time flies when we do what we love, and with so many new things we have been doing to SO BELOW, almost 8 months went by very quickly. But alas, here we are, happy to share a gigantic update with you, our brave hunters. Expect new enemies, new maps, new mechanics, new lore, and new thrilling horror waiting to be discovered.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/933218dd864ceaec55840ff3c99cbb4d45cf7fbd.jpg

New enemies 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/63d3dbdd7af27a1908822c3b51d5df3b4d79f579.jpg

The Wendigo is the most dangerous beast-type entity in the entire game. Its new AI system handles two coordinated wendigos that use joint attacks and luring tactics against the hunter. Solve the
puzzles while holding the Wendigo menace, claim back the new 
Greenwood Forest map. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/0b4310c15d7d6628dfd8cc00835872725b8edc40.jpg

Adepts are slow and very dangerous undead entities that were once human worshipers of Zultar. They are all-knowing creatures, so hiding is meaningless against it. With the Adepts we are proud 
to introduce our new insanity mechanic. Don’t stare into the Eye of the Adept for too long!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/aa43ea0e2631fcda60b061774b1aab7ce2885746.jpg

The Revenant is the first immortal entity in SO BELOW, so defeating it is a matter of agility and luring tactics. You can still use crucifixes and other holy objects to slow it down. Don’t be a hero, if you get ahold of his severed finger, run for the portal! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/bfbb704966e56ffe5612ed75ec4909565dfe998d.jpg

Watchers are a brand-new Shadow-type entity that can be defeated solely by the power of the flashing guns and photo cameras. However, looking directly into it will drive you mad, quickly. Avoid direct eye contact and you’ll be fine. 

New maps and old map improvements 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/928e900c14a98acc11b1dc04fe0c425df730389b.jpg

The HEXA headquarters (the game lobby) has been completely redesigned and overhauled. With three main areas and dynamic music, the whole feel of the place has a new vibe.

The brand-new warehouse contains an item workshop, hidden areas, and overall a lot of hidden content waiting to be discovered.

We renovated the trophy room and implemented a new inspection mechanic to learn more about your findings during hunts.

We implemented a research area with a working cinema to study the history behind all those haunted locations.

Finally, a company history room, so you know who your employers are.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/88960bacfb981561fa777a460aeecfc05b211921.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/607a89faa629715f381c26ae512ddade46a58129.jpg

Get ready for our first map outdoors. Get lost in this beautifully haunting forest filled with secrets. Take a break from the oppressive interiors of the buildings of old and dive into the oppressive darkness of the Greenwood Forest.
These woods are home to the Wendigo, don’t trust your ears. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/e28a894feac76f2c620c1cfa2e26c8d5661b5fe9.jpg

Reworks 

Every map received new treatments to adjust the new mechanics, so we took some time to fix a lot of tiny mistakes and weird situations in every map. We also added new cleansing stones for 
later updates related to the insanity and course mechanics. Speaking of new mechanics… 

New hunting tools 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/1626ae7eb429588da07a4d3bbde01f489fce70f0.jpg

Crucifixes and holy objects 


We expanded the Crucifix rooster with new holy objects: The good-old crucifix, the best all-round option for new hunters.


 The cross of Brigid, a handcrafted crucifix best suited against Banshees and other ghost-entities.


 The Egyptian cross, weak against shadows and banshees but powerful against undead entities.


 The Palm Leaf cross, best against beasts like the wendigo and the revenant, but weak against spirits.


 The Eye of God, a traditional cross from Mexico that’s best against the Banshees and weak against physical beasts.

The Bagua Mirror, best against shadows but weak against physical entities. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/8402af36fa439a98a8a136072f90a8a5a8f8acbe.jpg

Lure Machine 


We are happy to introduce a brand-new hunting tool, the Lure Machine. This device emits sounds specifically designed to attract specific entities. Just select the entity type and fire. The Lure Machine can “Aggro” the entity for a time, so use it to plan your hunts. 

Player inventory rework 


New item animations and player controllers  


For a long time we struggled with many hand objects and the ease of use of some of the hunting tools, so we revisited the whole controller and player animation systems. The renewed controller scheme is intuitive and responsive, but you have to try it yourself to see what we mean. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/46e0f9a5a00923e9ea209951c29364ec5c79f687.jpg

New in-game store 


Although having all the tools available from the beginning is one of the staples of SO BELOW, we are aware that sometimes you just need extra gear (like a different crucifix or extra defibrillators). 
That’s why we implemented an item bundle store before each hunt, as well as a gear vending machine once the hunt has started. 
This will allow you to adjust your strategy accordingly.  

Event logger and text chat 

We got tons of feedback regarding the clarity of the game loop and in general how to do things in SO BELOW. That’s why we implemented a logger system. It provides live feedback from all 
that’s happening during the hunt. It shows relevant information regarding entity activity, cursed objects and tools, game objectives, map information, and more. This system also allows 
the players to chat with text, in case you are not ready to use the voice chat of the game. The color of the text can be chosen in the character selection menu. 

Lore 


We implemented a new focusable object system that allows us to expand the lore of SO BELOW like never before. Now you can explore the haunted locations and learn more about the secret history of the Ascendants, their beliefs, and how it all relates to the entities haunting the many buildings acquired by HEXA. We also revisited the entity information at the beginning of every hunt. Our early design principles of keeping it ambiguous and mysterious backfired on us, so we made it as plain and simple as possible.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/25ee0d442fd359f4acf6d6c24e82b7e61260ce14.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/fe8043fd6fac7626e3b54ebf22392cd373fa3cd5.jpg

New insanity system 


We wanted more than a life bar, so we implemented a whole additional insanity system. Certain entities, objects, and even areas, can drive you insane and push you further into the dark corners of the mind, where you should not trust your senses. Of course, you are professional hunters, so just avoid situations that increase your insanity and you will get better overtime. Just, if you hear your own heartbeat, we recommend you to run and hide.

Item reworks 


We reskinned and reworked some old hand objects, such as the spectral microphone, the flashing gun, the torch, and the papyrus, to name a few. 

Papyrus 


The new Papyrus is now very easy to use. As a part of the whole controller rework, we realized that placing the papyrus was real trouble, so we made it easier than ever: just click to place. 

Flashing gun 


The flashing gun also changed skins, but more importantly, is operating controllers and its range has improved over past iterations. Now you can hold the trigger to ready your attack, and it no longer triggers itself automatically in the presence of an entity. This allows for better gameplay and strategy.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/b2f141c43c3e687e2c967fa9c39c25bb20e90837.jpg

The torch is now a powerful weapon against beast entities (like the wendigo and the revenant). You just need to keep the fire on and you can swing it as you would in a movie. Be careful though, they can also be broken by the entities. 

Spectral microphone 


The spectral microphone received a brand new skin and UI, prettier than ever. 

Bug fixes

Broken tutorial 

We got rid of the old tutorial level. It was confusing, it sometimes crashed the game, and it was very outdated. We decided to improve the overall information availability instead of implementing a tutorial. Frankly, we also hate tutorial levels to the bone, so yeah. 

Voice chat 


It might not seem like a big improvement, but after many months of struggle, the in-game voice chat is now working as we want it to. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/14e743c1826abc4eedbcfceadef483f06b104203.jpg

We revisited the contract table. Now, if the generated contracts are too much for you and your team, or if the map you wanted to explore is not available, you can refresh them (for a fee) and tend to other contracts more in line to your taste. We also improved the contract information, so you can make better decisions.

Additionally, we implemented weekly contracts that will be updated regularly from the HEXA headquarters.  

Collaborations 

We have been working with local artists and creators to enrich the lore and atmosphere of SO BELOW. 

Special thanks to our friends: 

Luis Augusto García Nevárez, Gleis 11, Josué Villagrán and Mike Hance.
Thank you friends, we love you.

notes.title: Worst Nightmares Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/232038e4d3128f4c5f4d1975e01fea8f31b19282.jpg

Gear up, hunters! 

We’re excited to release our latest SO BELOW update, where we put our most experienced hunters to the test with our new difficulty system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/d154def4547820399032f1c5afd5ff75b13d30bd.png

Now, hunters can pick contracts with a variety of game modifiers (and get paid handsomely) and also choose the relative boss difficulty. This means more money, more action, more pain, and more gain.

Depending on the default difficulty of the contract, you will get a set of modifiers that can range from a few visual challenges to survival mode with several entities at the same time. 

Environment and entity modifiers:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/a2c04cd85de3696a625ab664b97f4a330f849cd1.jpg

Unreliable electronics
All electronic devices tend to malfunction during the hunt.

Midnight Veil
All-encompassing darkness throughout the hunt. Compromised viewing distance. 

Cursed destiny
No cleansing altars on the map.

No EMF
Hunt the entities without any EMF.

Light my fire
No flashlights, only lighter and environmental lights. 

Diminished perception
No pin icons. Only voice lines.  

Survival mode
No defibrillators, just one try. 

Icy embrace
Cold weather reduces max player stamina by 20%.

Suffocating fog
Low visibility due to a high density mist in the hunt location.

Phantom menace 
Additional Geist entities reported at the hunting location.

Other difficulty adjustments:

Now haunted items can spawn on different locations depending on the difficulty. 
Improvements to the base ghost system. This means that we can now spawn many Nachtgeists at the same time depending on the difficulty. (Challenge for expert hunters only)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/0e5224190d24a55db7f25d3ceff2b31bf3e984ca.jpg

Difficulty multipliers 

Other improvements 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/c1d2060dfeaea94ee6496e4f479e8f431434809d.jpg

New HUD feedback
On the inventory HUD, you can now find your life and stamina bars, the Hunt Time, and a countdown timer before dawn (timeout ending).

New match summary
The session summary screen after the hunts has been improved with much more information. This means a clearer picture of the earnings of the hunt.  

Camera system improvements
Smoother camera movement for a more immersive experience. More improvements to come. 

Localization 
Full Japanese, Italian and French language localization. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/5780d61a3ab3694122fe73ec9cea222b648ed82f.jpg

Halloween season event (new entities and Zombie John). 

Abyssal terrors
Additional entities from the abyss reported at the hunting location.

Oftentimes, summoning rituals can (unintentionally) invoke terrors from the abyss. These hideous creatures come in two varieties: the blind and peaceful monsters from the underworld, and the omniscient relentless hunters. Good luck. 
Season unlocks

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/41f66fd9d51a7783a6f46f9d714d2556b1fc2919.jpg

HEXA Halloween event.

HEXA headquarters is under a spell. Explore the office and find the secret to unlock the new Zombie 
John skin (Season event). 
If you find it, share it to the community on steam or social media.
(YOU DO FOLLOW US ON SOCIAL MEDIA, RIGHT? )

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/a2492bf8f9f6ce80bbef092f5f7abe97ca4a42f5.png

Extras
Lots of bugfixing…

notes.title: No headbob update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/eaf07dac0cbcc393ab7d1722a5b5b7bad550c5a2.gif
Great news everyone!
We have been listening to you, and we are proud to announce that we successfully refactored the camera system to avoid the motion sickness caused by the previous camera implementation (the headbobbing issue). Now, this doesn’t mean that the old camera mode is entirely gone, you can now activate it on the menu by choosing the “immersive mode” in the game options (deactivated by default). Also, if you prefer a third-person view, you can switch modes by pressing “U”. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/c31ededb1eaad95c4a43c869c13eabd811c28a0e.jpg

Other Improvements


 The object-dropping system was improved; we solved the bugs regarding the dropping of objects out of boundaries.
 Sprint priority. Now sprinting overrides any other character state (aiming, camera, journal, etc.), this improves escape tactics. 
 Added 2K resolution.
 Improvements and stability when connecting to an ongoing hunting session. (Camera offset looking at the floor). 
 Menu cello cue correction to avoid sound overlapping. 
 New ending sequence for the Llorona (the Witch), new music, more time to escape the cave system, more dust and rockfall. 
 Improvements to the difficulty balance depending on the number of players. 
 Size adjustment for the Undead ritual room.
 Tutorial crash fix, cockroaches removed.
 

However, we still need your help. If you encounter any issue with the new camera mode or any other issue, please refer to our discord channel to report it. It really goes a long way.

https://discord.gg/yg4pQyME

notes.title: So Below Patch Notes - Version v0.1.3.0.02f04e
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome, fellow hunters!

We are excited to announce a new feature in So Below that we’re sure you'll love - the character store! You can now use in-game currency to purchase unique characters, skins, and backpacks. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/96b57f24dd8ea6ae08db9b48b1b40566c136721f.png

We know how important it is to have a character that reflects your unique style and personality, and with our new character store, now you can. We are working towards the future addition of more personalization options, such as decoration for the backpacks and haunting gear skins. Now all hunters will be able to show their expertise by wearing the official Hexa uniform. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/c6f8ee09100556ef81097961f16174ba446a6000.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/55970ae3a8b5431c81b7f2574f072c2e81cb903d.png

New Features:

Introducing the new Hexa Store. Players can now purchase new skins and more with the new in-game currency.
Introducing the new Character Packo! This pack includes a new character designed for our friend Packo, aka the streamer known as Gamehauntings, complete with unique cosmetic items.
Introducing the new Hunting Equipment, the Tablet! This item shows you the approximate location of the ghost and other hunters in the game, making it easier for players to track their targets and avoid getting lost.


Gameplay Changes:

Various gameplay changes have been made to improve the overall experience for players. These include improvements to hunt tracking data, experience and payment calculations and bug fixes for various achievements.
 General rework of all character models to greatly improve performance and aesthetics.
 Improvements to the hunt summary after each session. Players can now see a summary of their performance, including the earned experience, collected rewards, and captured ghosts.

Bug Fixes and Improvements:

 Various bugs and glitches have been fixed to improve the overall game experience. Huge thanks to all the people who have been reporting bugs on our discord and on steam. 
 The user interface has been updated to provide a more seamless and enjoyable experience for players.

Thank you for playing SO BELOW! We hope you enjoy these new features and changes, and we look forward to seeing you in the game.

Good hunting!
